I am proud to communicate that a second part of the game is underway. It is totally different, made with the Unreal Engine graphic engine from scratch and completely in third person.
Both the graphics, the performance, the design, and the game mode are much better, and I hope to be successful this time. Stay tuned ...

notes.title: We are preparing a next version 3
notes.content:
We are preparing next version 3 

Based on your suggestions:

- Total translation to Spanish
- Hopital level white haze is seen in the morge. Because Deferred rendering
- The positioner of the dead friend is kept even when he has already been resurrected.
- Text display "F to resucite" does not always work out well
- In yellow insect prologue shooting, improve movements
- Re-add the tripod scene in a prologue saying very clearly that he has to go to houses in front of him
- the slowdown is very confusing or remove it or make it one step
- The tripods and reapers that do not affect the ice, immune control of time
- The creature with shield in prologue kill badly
- Leave more time the warnings and more clearly to indicate what players should do
- Lower to 20 the preloaded ones in all the levels to accelerate loads of levels

Stay tunned

notes.title: Version 2 launched
notes.content:
- Partial Translation to Spanish.

- Modifications based on reviews as some aspects of the game are not understood. By example: Tripods scene in prologue deprecated

- Modification of the difficulty. For some the normal difficulty was too high.

- Shooting Start Production Video deprecated.

Please, a little patience, we will improve it over time. It is a complex and very laborious product.

The complete Spanish translation will be available in a few weeks. Like the translation in French and German.

Translations to Chinese, Russian and Japanese will take longer because we have to adapt the application to non-Latin alphabets.

We will improve the movements of the aliens and in particular those of the tripods.

Thank you for your support and please, transmit us your suggestions and problems that you are seeing. We exposed for months a reduced free Demo version and nobody told us anything

notes.title: We are preparing a next version 2
notes.content:
We are preparing the final version 2. In it we will include:

- Translation to Spanish.

- Modifications based on reviews as some aspects of the game are not understood.

- Modification of the difficulty. The normal difficulty is too high, although it can always be adjusted as easy.

-Ported to Linux

Stay tunned
Thanks

notes.title: We are working in the final stretch of development
notes.content:
We are proud to inform you that we will soon be able to publish a version with 10 levels of the 14 initially planned for the videogame. We are working hard to provide hours of fun with optimal performance.
The work takes a little delay but in any case our commitment is to finish it before the end of September. Stay tuned
